messages.content: Hello, George! How can I assist you today?
I live in NYC. Do you know the weather today?

Hello again, George! I can provide a general idea of the weather in New York City today, but for the most accurate and up-to-date information, I recommend checking a reliable weather service or app. Typically, NYC experiences cool to mild temperatures in the fall, with possibilities of rain. Would you like a general overview of the weather, or do you have any specific plans that might require a more detailed forecast?
